test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word: The knight raised his **pauldron **before mounting.

options.text: The armourer polished the metal pauldron carefully.
The sculptor studied the design carved on the pauldron.
The biologist examined the pauldron of the marine creature.
The gallery displayed a medieval pauldron.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"pauldron"** refers to a piece of armor that covers the shoulder, commonly used in medieval times. (कंधे का कवच) • **Example: **The knight's pauldron was intricately designed to reflect his rank and family crest. • In the correct answer (Option 3), "pauldron" is used as a homonym to describe a structure on a marine creature, which is anatomically similar to the shoulder armor. (समुद्री जीव का संरचनात्मक अंग) • **Example: **The marine biologist studied the unique features of the creature's pauldron to understand its defense mechanism. • Homonyms are words that have the same spelling or pronunciation but different meanings. In this context, the word "pauldron" has two distinct meanings: one related to medieval armor and the other to marine biology. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1:** The armourer polished the metal pauldron carefully. (कवच बनाने वाला व्यक्ति सावधानी से धातु के कवच को चमका रहा था।) • **Example:** The armourer ensured that the pauldron was spotless and ready for the knight. • **Option 2:** The sculptor studied the design carved on the pauldron. (मूर्तिकार कवच पर उकेरी गई डिज़ाइन का अध्ययन कर रहा था।) • **Example:** The sculptor admired the intricate patterns etched onto the medieval pauldron. • **Option 4:** The gallery displayed a medieval pauldron. (गैलरी ने एक मध्यकालीन कवच प्रदर्शित किया।) • **Example:** Among the artifacts was a medieval pauldron, showcasing the craftsmanship of the era. 41:Tc9f, The correct answer is **Option 2**.
